description: This file provides documentation for various custom response classes used in FastAPI, including import statements, class descriptions, and options for each response type.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.UJSONResponse
classes.description: A custom response class for JSON responses optimized with UJSON, including options like charset, status_code, media_type, body, background, headers, cookies, and rendering.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.ORJSONResponse
classes.description: A custom response class for JSON responses optimized with ORJSON, with similar options to UJSONResponse.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.FileResponse
classes.description: A response class for serving files, with options for chunk size, charset, media type, headers, and cookies.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.HTMLResponse
classes.description: A response class for returning HTML content.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.JSONResponse
classes.description: A standard JSON response class, with customizable options for charset, status_code, media_type, headers, and cookies.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.PlainTextResponse
classes.description: A response class for returning plain text content.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.RedirectResponse
classes.description: A response class for HTTP redirects, with options for charset, status code, headers, and cookies.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.Response
classes.description: The base response class in FastAPI, allowing for custom responses with configurable headers, status code, media type, and body.

classes.name: fastapi.responses.StreamingResponse
classes.description: A response class for streaming data, accepting an iterator or async iterator, with options for charset, status code, media type, headers, and cookies.
